rows.title: Containment
notes: “that track right there is called containment it comes from the album called bitter balls”
Confirmed: 'Containment' is track 3 on Karkhana's 2020 album 'Bitter Balls', a septet featuring members of Dwarfs of East Agouza and Konstrukt.

rows.title: Rising Falling
notes: “the next song i want to play to you is called rising falling it's from the record towards an expanse by south african artist dumama”
Confirmed: track 5 on South African artist Dumama's debut solo album 'Towards An Expanse' (Soundway Records).

rows.title: Hadikat Al-Ams (حديقة الأمس)
notes: “cuts from marissa anderson as well as sana hadikat al-ams ... if you're not familiar with sanam they're a just wow an incredible group straight coming from beirut lebanon”
Track from Sanam's 2025 album 'Sametou Sawtan' — Beirut krautrock/free-rock/Arabic-maqam group.

rows.title: Quantum Dreamers, A Prophecy from the Scorched Earth
notes: “That was Quantum Dreamers, A Prophecy from the Scorched Earth from Sangakala by Raja Kirik, straight out of Yes No Wave Music”
Opening track of the album 'Sengkala' (presenter's 'Sangakala' is a mishearing) on Indonesian netlabel Yes No Wave Music.

rows.title: witched windows (v.2)
notes: “it's called witched windows v brackets v2 it's from this berlin percussionist and composer weston olenki ... this is witch windows from western alenki”
Track on Berlin-based composer Weston Olencki's album 'Verd Mont'; correct spelling is Olencki, not Olenki.

rows.title: The Underworld
notes: “Tana and Yantin Kessou at the start really setting in the tone with that song The Underworld”
“Jumama, Karkana, Tana and Yantin Kessou”
Presenter thanking several real acts played in the show (Dumama, Karkhana, and the 'Tana and Yantin Kessou' artist from The Underworld) — no specific track named here.
“songs from Vanessa Amara, Jumama, Karkana”
'Jumama' is a mishearing of Dumama; presenter naming artists played (Dumama, Vanessa Amara, Karkhana), not a specific track.

rows.title: Heart
notes: 2026 True Panther Records

rows.title: Shakl-e Barqi / Aftab Zadagi (Slight Return)
notes: “That's Radio Kiaban, straight out of the Netherlands in Tilburg”
Radio Khiyaban is the Tilburg (NL) label/platform; this track is by Afghan-American outfit Naujawanan Baidar — strong phonetic match to the ASR title.

rows.title: Roaming the Mountain (破城入山)
notes: “this is ramming it through ramming the town roaming the mountain from scattered purgatory it was released in 2014 ... this is our from the album Lost Ethnography of the Miscanthus Ocean”
Taiwanese drone/ambient trio; track from the 2014 compilation 'Lost Ethnography of the Miscanthus Ocean' — matches presenter's stumbled title and year exactly.

rows.title: Queen Of The Suburbs
notes: 2025 Bedroom Suck Records

rows.title: Piano, Accordion, Cello, Electric Guitar & Chamber Organ - KK 22/06/2017 (Live)
notes: “we also listened to tracks from um vanessa amara which was called piano accordion cello electric guitar and chamber orchestra live ... it's that live version from 22nd of the 6th 2017”
mentioned by the presenter but we couldn't work out when it played
Copenhagen duo on Posh Isolation; live recording dated 22/06/2017 matches presenter's date exactly ('chamber orchestra' is a mishearing of 'chamber organ').
“we had cuts from Chabelle Haber, Ellory Saxel and Henry Solomon”
mentioned by the presenter but we couldn't work out when it played
Real Lebanese guitarist/Scrambled Eggs co-founder with an active Bandcamp catalogue, alongside Elori Saxl and Henry Solomon — but no specific track title was stated.
